summary.en: Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents and their kin in filex with ONLYOFFICE's editor, in your browser and without a Document Server - alone or together, in encrypted folders too. Since 0.4.0 it also brings filex a server engine for office thumbnails and conversions.
